consult.note: minimum_delta set from the measured noise floor (paired-bootstrap / paired-comparison, k=20, sweeps/paired_bootstrap.sidecar.tsv) and metric.bound.ideal declared as 1.0 in the same edit — the engine refuses a bound without a floor estimand, so the two could not be separated. No prediction, tolerance, target, rung or phase changed: study.yaml's diff is the two floor blocks plus the bound. Phase 0 ran after the DATA and METHOD gates and before any ledger row.

data.reason: data_card.md is NO-GO on one mechanized leakage row: 615 row-content hashes straddle the partitions (5.12% of development rows, 5.32% of sealed rows have a byte-identical training twin). Accepted, not fixed, for three reasons on the record in program.md: (1) the cause is the dataset's coarse rating structure, not this study's preparation - 6.1% of the whole table sits in a duplicate-content group, and tables/duplicate_exposure.tsv shows the v1 study this port reproduces carried the same 5.22% in its own validation partition, unmeasured; (2) both available fixes (dedupe in prepare.py, or a content-hash group split) change which rows are trained on, which destroys the train-partition identity with v1 that predictions P1, P2 and P4 are registered against, and repairs nothing about the v1 number being reproduced; (3) policy_id, the only identifier of an individual policy, is dropped and crosses nothing - what the check reports is feature resolution, and for a rating model the modelling unit is the cell, not the policy. The risk is carried with a number attached: train.py prints twin_free_rows, twin_free_auc and twin_free_gap on every run, so every rung reports its AUC on the evaluation rows with no training twin, and findings scope every generalisation sentence by that gap. data_card.md is left saying NO-GO - the auditor's verdict is not edited to unlock a gate.

P8.explanation: The v1 ledger's row 6 recorded a keep on a learning-rate sweep whose lift over row 3 was 0.664322 - 0.662897 = 0.001425. This study's measured paired-comparison floor is minimum_delta 0.0375805 (sweep:paired_bootstrap, k=20, max(2*std, range/2), std 0.0173021). 0.001425 / 0.0375805 = 0.0379 floors, so that transaction moved the metric by under four hundredths of the smallest difference this instrument can resolve on these rows; under the stricter 1000-replicate bar (0.043229, sweep:paired_bootstrap_b1000) it is 0.0330 floors. Under a measured keep bar it would have been a discard. The prediction carries no arithmetic rule because no single run prints both numbers: one is a scouted constant from another study's ledger and the other is a Phase 0 sidecar.
